case.subject: Anthropic's Messages API migration to Rust
case.problem: A live API rewrite needed behavioral verification.
case.workflow: Agents compared versions in sandboxes; engineers reviewed fixes before shadow-traffic validation.
case.result: Anthropic reports completing the migration without service downtime.
case.result_basis: Vendor engineering account, not independent measurement.
case.measurement_context: One internal production migration; no universal savings claim.
case.case_date: Public traffic moved September 2026; write-up November 25, 2026.
case.limitation: Passing a local checker did not establish a sound shipping decision; human review remained important.
case.listener_action: Hypothetical exercise: compare old/new CSV formatting on three synthetic edge cases and inspect differences before accepting a change. Not a performed test.
case.availability: Published engineering technique; internal migration infrastructure is not a generally available product.
